findings.classification: Confirmed by complete source trace and primary platform documentation; not runtime-reproduced.
findings.title: Rejecting verbatim prefixes blocks ordinary canonicalized Windows database paths
findings.trigger: A valid Windows managed installation uses the default storage root or a storage/database path relative to its install configuration. Root/config binding canonicalizes those existing paths, producing an extended-length VerbatimDisk or VerbatimUNC prefix, retained into the active generation database path.
findings.consequence: Graph search, context, graph query and health database reads fail with database_path_prefix_unsupported before native opening, despite using ordinary program-generated paths. This affects normal internal resolver output, not merely unsupported caller aliases.

trace.claim: bind_repo_selector canonicalizes repository root/config using fs::canonicalize.
Rust documents that Windows canonicalize returns extended-length syntax.
RepoPaths derives state beneath canonical root; default managed storage and relative configured paths inherit the prefix. Runtime clones active snapshot db_path.
ManagedLayout and generation/database joins preserve the storage-root prefix.
GraphStorage preserves supplied ManagedLayout and active snapshot carries generation.db_path.
Search/context/query pass runtime.db_path unchanged to graph_read.
All native read entry points use the guarded opener.
The Windows allowlist accepts Disk/UNC only; both VerbatimDisk and VerbatimUNC reject before the native constructor.

findings.baseline_distinction: The baseline and original wrapper did not contain this Windows prefix rejection; this deterministic guard failure is introduced by the path-fix helper.
findings.counterevidence_scope: Explicit ordinary absolute Disk/UNC storage paths may bypass this trigger. That does not cover default root-derived or relative-config paths. The approved strict alias restriction does not establish permission to reject normal resolver-produced Windows paths.

sdk_assessment.rust: lbug0.19.0 database.rs137-154 converts Path display text and forwards the full string.
sdk_assessment.native: StorageUtils::expandPath72-107 treats leading double backslash as a Windows UNC path for avoiding CWD, and lexically_normalizes without an explicit verbatim-prefix rejection. LocalFileSystem::openFile89-134 passes its resulting string to CreateFileA.
sdk_assessment.support_limit: The source does not establish that stripping all extended prefixes is lossless. Extended namespace parsing and length behavior differ; the SDK uses a narrow ANSI API, so arbitrary Unicode/code-page equivalence is also not demonstrated. No universal projection or arbitrary verbatim acceptance is asserted.
sdk_assessment.correction_target: Preserve ordinary program-generated canonicalized Windows disk/UNC paths using a demonstrably exact supported representation consistently for both guard and native open. Keep unsupported/device/ambiguous forms strict and preserve raw Direct writer/journal address keys. Do not change those persisted identities as a prefix repair.
sdk_assessment.verification_needed: Run Windows-native public runtime search/query/materialization through fs::canonicalize-derived disk paths, with appropriate UNC coverage where available, and verify actual resource-family exclusion for the chosen representation. Include relevant normalization, long-path and encoding boundaries. No Windows support conclusion should be drawn from Darwin-only cfg exclusion.
